autochattranslator.title: Auto Chat Translator · Settings
autochattranslator.save_hint: Click Done to save and apply without restarting. Undo discards unsaved edits.
autochattranslator.privacy: Text is sent to the selected endpoint. Keys are masked here but stored in plain text in the local config file. Do not share that file.
autochattranslator.option.enabled.descri: Translate incoming foreign-language chat. Saving also clears a temporary /ctrans toggle pause; this switch determines the final state.
autochattranslator.option.targetLanguage: Language code: zh-CN for Simplified Chinese, en for English, ja for Japanese. Default: zh-CN. Do not leave blank.
autochattranslator.option.sourceLanguage: Use auto to detect the language, or a code such as en or ja. Default: auto. Do not leave blank.
autochattranslator.option.translatePlaye: Keep the original message and append its translation on a new line.
autochattranslator.option.translateSyste: Includes server notices and some mod / NPC dialogue. Try enabling this for missing Verity translations. Disabled by default to reduce spam.
autochattranslator.option.translateOwnMe: Also translate your messages as displayed in chat. Does not alter the text sent to the server.
autochattranslator.option.showSender.des: Include the sender name before translated player chat.
autochattranslator.option.translationPre: Text before each translation. Default: [译] followed by a space. Leave blank to hide the prefix.
autochattranslator.option.provider.descr: MyMemory needs no key. Google depends on network access. OpenAI-compatible services include MiMo. DeepL needs a key. Only the selected service is used; saving clears cached translations.
autochattranslator.option.mymemoryEndpoi: Usually leave unchanged. The free service has quotas and rate limits. Text is sent to this address.
May be blank. If provided, it is sent to MyMemory with each request for a higher daily quota.
autochattranslator.option.googleEndpoint: Your network must be able to reach the configured translation service.
A trusted OpenAI-compatible base URL, usually ending in /v1. Defaults to Xiaomi MiMo. Do not append /chat/completions. Your key is sent to this address.
autochattranslator.option.openaiModel.de: The full model name offered by the service. Default: mimo-v2.6-flash.
autochattranslator.option.openaiApiKey.d: Click to type or paste. Always displayed as asterisks. Keys are not copied from other mods. May be blank for local services without authentication; stored in plain text on disk.
autochattranslator.option.openaiMaxToken: Maximum translation output per request, 32–4096. Default: 512. Low values may truncate translations.
Free keys use the default api-free.deepl.com endpoint. Paid keys use the appropriate official endpoint. Your key is sent to this address.
autochattranslator.option.deeplApiKey.de: Your DeepL API key. Displayed as asterisks but stored in plain text on disk. Do not share the config file.
autochattranslator.option.minLength.desc: Skip shorter messages, measured in characters. Range: 1–100. Increasing beyond the maximum also raises the maximum.
autochattranslator.option.maxLength.desc: Skip longer messages, measured in characters. Range: 10–4000. Decreasing below the minimum also lowers the minimum.
autochattranslator.option.cacheSize.desc: Number of translations retained in memory, 0–5000. Zero disables caching. Saving settings clears the current cache.
autochattranslator.option.timeoutSeconds: Maximum time for a translation request, 3–60 seconds. Waiting does not block the game thread.
autochattranslator.option.debug.descript: Log stack traces when translation fails. Enable when diagnosing issues. Check logs for private data before sharing them.
